title: Where your learning data is saved
subtitle: Studio writes only to the store you choose — it never mirrors data into the other one.
sqlitePros: One file on disk, shared with the CLI — easy to back up and keep.
browserPros: No setup, never leaves this device.
browserCons: Cleared if you clear site data; may be evicted; not shared with the CLI.
serverDown: The local server isn’t running — run
movedMessage: Moved {count} {recordWord} to {target}. The old copy is kept until you remove it.
switchedMessage: Switched to {target}. The old copy was left untouched.
oldCopyThere: The old copy in {from} is still there.
removeOldConfirm: Remove the old copy in {label}? This cannot be undone.
moveUnavailable: The current store can’t be read right now, so nothing will be copied. Switching keeps your existing copy untouched — you can move it later once the local server is running.
moveBody: Move {courses} {courseWord} and {cards} {cardWord} to {target}? The old copy stays until you remove it.
secretsNote: API keys and settings are never moved.
